title: QuantForge TradingView alert payload, version 1
description: The message of a TradingView alert that QuantForge executes: an entry or an exit on one futures instrument, for one automation profile. docs/signal-payload.md is the contract; this schema is its shape. A payload the schema refuses is never a signal. One the schema accepts may still be refused, for what a schema cannot see: a member written twice, a body over 4096 bytes, a day the calendar lacks, a bar time after the fire time, or a price an exact decimal cannot hold.

entry.title: An entry alert
entry.description: Opens a position on the side it names, sized by the profile's policy from the expected price and the stop.

kind.description: A constant of the alert: this template enters.

price.description: The expected entry price, in the instrument's quote asset: "{{close}}" in a template, in quotes. The position is sized from it.

stop.description: The absolute stop price, in the instrument's quote asset, when the alert has one, such as "{{plot_0}}" in quotes. Left out, the profile's fallback percentage applies; an entry with neither is refused.

exit.title: An exit or take-profit alert
exit.description: Closes the position of the side it names that an earlier entry of the same profile opened. It carries no price and no stop.

kind.description: A constant of the alert: this template exits.

version.description: The payload format's version: the number 1, not text.

profile.description: The automation profile the alert is for, by the name the operator gave it. It must be the profile the webhook URL selects; it chooses nothing by itself.

source.description: A constant name for this alert, chosen once by the operator, such as trend. It starts the signal's ID, so two alerts that may fire on one bar need two names.

ticker.description: "{{ticker}}" in a template: TradingView's name of a perpetual, such as SOLUSDT.P, or the venue's own symbol of an asset the profile has settings for. Uppercase, without the exchange before it and without spaces.

exchange.description: Optional. "{{exchange}}" in a template: the exchange of the chart, such as BYBIT. When given it must be the profile's venue.

category.description: Optional. The product family the alert is meant for. When given it must be the profile's.

side.description: A constant of the alert: the side an entry opens, or the side an exit closes. Never an order's buy or sell.

bar_time.description: "{{time}}" in a template: the time of the bar the alert fired on. It ends the signal's ID.

fire_time.description: "{{timenow}}" in a template: when the alert fired. An entry is held to the profile's age limit by it, and an exit closes only a position entered before it.

time.description: A UTC time to the second, as TradingView renders one: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, from 1970 on.

price.description: A price above zero as a JSON string of its digits: no sign, no exponent, no separators, at most 28 decimal places.
